vocabulary.meaning: the writer's or speaker's attitude in communication
the level of formality or informality in language
showing small differences or subtle shades of meaning
using irony to mock or show contempt
language used in ordinary or familiar conversation
confident and likely to be respected or obeyed
having more than one possible meaning

grammar_tips.title: Choosing the Right Register
grammar_tips.explanation: Use more formal words in professional or academic settings. Example: 'request' instead of 'ask for'.

grammar_tips.title: Contractions and Informality
grammar_tips.explanation: Contractions (e.g., 'can't', 'won't') make speech informal. Avoid them in formal writing.
